name: Team Member Carousel
description: Dark 3D coverflow carousel of team portraits with a glowing accent backdrop, animated name and role caption, arrow buttons, counter and progress pills.
contents: Eyebrow and heading above the carousel
Perspective card stack of member photos
behavior: Active card centered, neighbors tilt back in 3D and fade
Navigate by buttons, clicking a card or pill, arrow keys, or swipe
Caption fades out and in on change
Card size and offsets switch at 768px and below
editableByProps: Card sizes on desktop and mobile

needsCodeEdit.change: Adjust 3D spacing and tilt of side cards
needsCodeEdit.where: transformStyles assignments in the items.map callback

fixed: Adds window keydown listener for arrow keys while mounted and removes it on unmount
Root is at least full viewport height
